name: Balloon Fiesta Navigator Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteers called Navigators help. They work before the event. They work during it. They work after it.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. Page says check back after the 2026 event for 2027 information.

name: Conservation Camp Counselors at the ABQ BioPark
what_you_do: Teens help a Camp BioPark teacher with hands-on activities, games and art projects. They set up, clean up and keep the space safe at the Zoo, Aquarium or Botanic Garden.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 20. The 2026 program ran June 1 to July 25.

name: ABQ BioPark High School Internship
what_you_do: A part-time paid internship on an animal care team or a plant team. You help feed animals, make toys for them and talk to guests about your area.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Mar 1 to Mar 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; expect March.

name: Nature Guides (teen volunteers)
what_you_do: In summer, volunteers move between the Zoo, Aquarium and Botanic Garden. They run hands-on learning areas and teach guests about animals and plants.
deadline_text: 2026 application deadline was May 20 (virtual open house May 16). 2027 dates not posted.

name: BioPark Education Student Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens help with classes, make teaching props and set up workshops. They also help at the zoo, aquarium or botanic garden for a semester.
deadline_text: Applications taken all year. Placements usually made at the start of each semester.

name: Aquatics Aide and Lifeguard (City pools)
what_you_do: Seasonal jobs at City swimming pools: aquatics aide or lifeguard. Lifeguards must pass a City water test first.
deadline_text: The page lists no dates or deadlines.

name: Career Pathways Internship at X Studio
org: Explora Science Center and Children's Museum
what_you_do: A paid internship that lasts 2 years, for rising juniors and seniors who like STEAM jobs. You work 10 to 20 hours a week.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran July 20 to Aug 26, 2026, interviews Aug 31 to Sept 5, onboarding Sept 19. 2027 dates not posted; expect summer.

name: Explora Volunteers
org: Explora Science Center and Children's Museum
what_you_do: Volunteers help teachers run programs and talk with guests about the exhibits. They join outreach around New Mexico and help keep the museum clean.
deadline_text: No deadline. Fill out the interest form any time.

name: Job Mentor Program Summer Internship
org: Youth and Family Services, City of Albuquerque
what_you_do: Seven-week paid summer internship with a City department, government agency or nonprofit. You work up to 25 hours a week.
deadline_text: The page gives no spring dates or year for applications. Apply during the spring window on the City's Jobs and Internships page.

name: Mayor's Creative Youth Corps
what_you_do: A paid summer mentorship in arts-based leadership. Youth are placed with community partners and mentors. More than 80 local youth took part over the last two summers.
deadline_text: No application dates posted on the page.

name: Mayor's Youth Advisory Council (MYAC)
what_you_do: Up to 21 high school students advise the Mayor's office on city issues from the youth point of view.
deadline_text: Application dates not posted on the page.

name: Junior Docents at the NM Museum of Natural History and Science
org: New Mexico Museum of Natural History and Science
what_you_do: Teens work in the museum's exhibit halls. They talk with visitors about science, help at events and can pick a special project.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 15, 2026. The program page says to check back in January 2027 for the 2027 program.

name: Volunteer Internships at the National Museum of Nuclear Science and History
org: National Museum of Nuclear Science and History
what_you_do: Interns pick a project that fits academic goals and museum goals. They also help with education programs and special events. A general track rotates you through the museum.
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the program page.

name: Warehouse Volunteers at Roadrunner Food Bank of New Mexico
org: Roadrunner Food Bank of New Mexico
what_you_do: Volunteers prep food for distribution in the warehouse. The food leaves the docks for hundreds of locations across the state. Shifts are at the Albuquerque warehouse.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for open dates and times.

name: Sandia National Laboratories High School Internships
what_you_do: High school students work on real tech or business projects. Mentors help them. Sandia has posted Technical High School internships (summer and year round) in areas like mechanical design.
deadline_text: Jobs are posted one by one on Sandia's careers site. Each has its own dates.

name: Engineering and Computing Summer Academy (UNM)
org: University of New Mexico Engineering Student Success Center
what_you_do: Do hands-on work in engineering and computer science. Meet UNM students and STEM faculty. Meet people who work in the field.
grades: Incoming grades 8 to 12 (depends on the option)
deadline_text: The 2026 priority deadline was March 15, 2026. The page lists no 2027 dates.

name: Youth Volunteer at UNM Health (Guest Services)
what_you_do: Volunteers help at Guest Services. The place is UNM Sandoval Regional Medical Center. The page lists a youth form for teens.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Call the volunteer office to learn more.

name: PATH Emerging Scholars Program (UNM Health Sciences)
org: University of New Mexico Health Sciences, Office for Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
what_you_do: A one-week program on health careers. Students see clinical or research work, study health equity and do community projects.
grades: High school juniors and seniors (the page also lists rising sophomores)
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was December 31, 2025 and the 2026 program ran June 15 to 24. The page lists no 2027 dates.

name: Youth Arts Leadership (YAL)
what_you_do: Young artists get paid work in the arts. They also grow personal and work skills and learn to organize their culture, through art projects, community work, service learning and goal setting.
deadline_text: Page says more information about the 2027 program is coming soon. Email programs@workingclassroom.org to get on the notification list.

name: Petroglyph National Monument Beautification
what_you_do: Paid summer youth jobs and job skills training. You help care for and clean up Petroglyph National Monument in west Albuquerque. The National Park Service pays for it.
deadline_text: Page says recruitment begins in April each year.

name: YouthBuild Albuquerque
what_you_do: Young people learn building and safety trades. They also earn a high school equivalency (GED or HiSET) and NCCER Core Construction and OSHA 10 papers. Help with rides and child care is offered.
deadline_text: Page says a final YouthBuild cohort is coming soon. No dates posted.

name: One Albuquerque Youth Job & Volunteer Fair
what_you_do: A fair each year where youth meet City teams and local employers. You learn how to apply and sign up for seasonal jobs, internships and volunteer roles.
deadline_text: 2026 fair was Saturday Feb 7, 2026, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Berna Facio Professional Development Center. 2027 date not posted.

name: Future U Youth and Young Adult Program
what_you_do: Get help with school, job training, and finding work. You can get on-the-job training, apprenticeships, GED prep, and career exploration.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed on the program page.

name: Teen Volunteer (Arapahoe Libraries)
what_you_do: Teens help with shelving, displays, book picks and events. Join a team for a semester or the summer, or join a monthly Teen Advisory Board.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted on the page.

name: Arizona 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Do hands-on projects in science, agriculture, health and civic engagement with adult mentors. Teens can apply for state teen leader groups, camps and shooting sports.
deadline_text: Join through your local Cooperative Extension office.

name: INSPIRE Summer Program (Access ASU)
what_you_do: Stay in an ASU residence hall for a week. Do hands-on projects, cultural activities, and college prep. Meet ASU students, staff, and faculty.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 ran June 21 to 25 and applications are closed. Next dates are not stated on the program page.

name: RISE Summer Leadership Institute
what_you_do: Live on the ASU campus for a few days. Work on leadership, starting a business, and community projects. Talk with working professionals.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 ran June 14 to 17 and applications are closed. Next dates are not stated on the program page.

name: Joaquin Bustoz Math-Science Honors Program (JBMSHP)
what_you_do: Take a 3-credit college math class over the summer. You can pick College Algebra, Pre-Calculus, or Calculus for Engineers I.
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2027 open in early December. Student application is due Feb 16, 2027. Recommender letter is due Feb 18, 2027.

name: Fleischer Scholars Program
org: Arizona State University, W. P. Carey School of Business
what_you_do: Join online sessions with mentors and staff. Earn one elective ASU college credit. Visit the Tempe campus. Learn to think strategically.
deadline_text: The program page lists Feb 15 for priority, March 15 for late, and May 6 as the final deadline for the summer 2027 group. It does not write the year for these dates.

name: Boulder County Youth Corps
what_you_do: Work in a summer crew on projects for Boulder County, towns and cities, like building trails. You learn work habits, teamwork and care for the environment.
deadline_text: The 2026 positions are filled. The page says positions for the 2027 season will be announced in January. The deadline for teen jobs in past years was in early April.

name: Youth Opportunities Advisory Board (City of Boulder)
org: City of Boulder, Youth Opportunities Program
what_you_do: Join up to 16 Boulder teens who advise the city. You give teen ideas on city plans and run a grant program that pays for youth programs.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the page.

name: Teen Art Camp: SUMA ARTventures
org: Southern Utah Museum of Art, Southern Utah University
what_you_do: Make art inspired by nature for four days. Try photo methods, outdoor painting, printmaking and collage. You also tour the museum galleries.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 16 to 19, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: SUU/BZI Youth Engineering Academy Teen Camps
org: Southern Utah University and Southwest Tech
what_you_do: Join a summer STEM camp for teens. Past topics include green energy, cybersecurity and AI, welding and culinary. You try real career skills with hands-on projects.
deadline_text: Registration opens in January. Each camp closes when it is full or about two weeks before it starts.

name: Chandler Aquatics Jobs (Lifeguard and Swim Instructor)
what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard or swim instructor with Chandler Aquatics. The page also lists head lifeguard and head swim coach roles.
deadline_text: Hiring for lifeguards runs each year from January through April.

name: Teen Volunteer at Banner Ocotillo Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital area such as the info desk, supply room or gift shop. You work one 4-hour shift a week.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Library Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer one shift each week at a Chandler library branch. Sessions follow the school year, by semester, quarter or summer break.
deadline_text: Closed now. Downtown: check back in January. Sunset: check back in December for spring 2027. Basha: check back in May for summer. Hamilton: check back at the start of the school year.

name: Summer Teen Program: Junior Zoo Keepers and Junior Camp Educators
what_you_do: High school teens spend the summer working with the zoo as Junior Zoo Keepers or Junior Camp Educators. Learn about animal care or teach kids at zoo camps.
deadline_text: Applications open February 1 to February 10, 2027. No late applications. The program runs June 1 to August 8, 2027.

name: Youth Volunteer (Clark Planetarium)
what_you_do: Help guests. Explain exhibits. Run science shows. Help at public star parties at a planetarium.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

name: Colorado 4-H
what_you_do: Join a county 4-H club and pick projects like livestock, science, food or sewing. You learn to lead, build hobbies and serve your community.
deadline_text: Projects can be added or dropped until March 1. Contact your county office for its enrollment dates.

name: Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teens help in hospital teams and at fundraisers. They do crafts and play with kids, and can join a teen advice group.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Applications are processed in the order received.

name: Colorado FFA Association
what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's agriculture class. Build leadership and career skills, enter contests such as career and leadership events and run for a state officer spot.
deadline_text: Join through your school's ag program.

name: Governor's Summer Job Hunt
org: Colorado Department of Labor and Employment, with local Workforce Centers
what_you_do: A free statewide service that lists summer job openings for young people and helps with job readiness. You register at a Workforce Center.
deadline_text: Not stated. Register at any Workforce Center.

name: Forge and Form Summer Studio (Mines Labriola Innovation Hub)
org: Colorado School of Mines, Labriola Innovation Hub
what_you_do: Spend one week on the Mines campus in Golden building and designing with materials science and engineering. 30 students per session. Lunch included.
deadline_text: The 2026 applications closed March 1 at 11:59 PM MST. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Colorado Springs Chief's Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Meet once a month with the police chief as your high school's student voice. Learn about police units, see demos and share what teens think about local issues.
deadline_text: Dates are not stated on the page. Use the Download Applications link on the page.

name: Space Ambassador Volunteer (Space Foundation Discovery Center)
what_you_do: Help visitors at a space science museum. Jobs include gallery guide work, helping in a Mars robot lab, and talks on a Science On a Sphere display. You can also help in a 3D printing lab or the drone zone.
deadline_text: The page says it is still taking applications. The museum plans to reopen in January 2027.

name: Summer Teen Volunteering (Colorado Springs Parks)
org: City of Colorado Springs Parks, Recreation and Cultural Services
what_you_do: Pick a summer job as a teen volunteer. You can be a junior guide at Rock Ledge Ranch, help at a spray ground, or greet visitors at North Cheyenne Canon Park. You can also help at the Therapeutic Recreation Discovery Camp.
deadline_text: Most jobs show 2026 dates only. Rock Ledge Ranch spots were filled for 2026, and its application window was March 1 to 21. The Pioneers Museum Junior Docent lists June to August 2027, with applications due early May 2027.

name: Colorado Youth Advisory Council (COYAC)
what_you_do: Work with teens from all over Colorado to study issues. Write ideas for lawmakers. Join monthly online meetings, a policy group, a retreat and a Day at the Capitol.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 to 2027 are closed. The page says applications open again in spring 2027 for the group that starts July 1, 2027.

name: STEM Research Experience (CU Boulder Science Discovery)

deadline_text: Application opens mid-December 2026. Deadline March 16, 2027 at 11:59 PM MT. Notified by March 23, 2027.

name: Science Discovery Summer Classes for High School (CU Boulder)
org: University of Colorado Boulder, Science Discovery
what_you_do: Take a 1 week STEM class that gives no college credit. Sample classes cover space flight, robots, the brain, crime science and computers.
deadline_text: The page refers to high school classes for summer 2026. No 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: A school year and summer program for teens who would be the first in their family to go to college. It has monthly Saturday classes. It also has a 2 week summer program after 10th grade and a 5 week program after 11th grade.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Contact the program manager before completing any forms.

name: Teen Studio at the Denver Art Museum
what_you_do: Spend one week in a five-day museum studio workshop, 9:30 am to 3:30 pm. Teens make their own art. Workshops are for ages 12 to 14 or ages 15 to 17.
deadline_text: The 2026 workshops ran July 13 to 31. Next dates are not stated on the program page.

name: Summer Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Pick the plant track or the guest track. The plant track covers gardening and nature science, with garden care, farm share help and pest control. The guest track is about helping guests and sharing science, like Science Chats.
deadline_text: The page says summer 2026 applications are closed. No 2027 dates are posted.

name: Job Shadowing Program
what_you_do: Follow a health care worker at Denver Health to see a normal workday. You learn the skills and school needed for that job.
deadline_text: The application was closed after July 31, 2026. The page says it is expected to reopen in early November 2026 for winter break shadowing.

name: Medical Career Collaborative (MC2) High School Internship
org: Denver Health with Children's Hospital Colorado
city: Denver metro and Colorado Springs, CO
what_you_do: A health careers program for juniors and seniors. You do a paid internship of 100 to 120 hours at Denver Health or Children's Colorado. You also join weekly classes and earn small health certificates.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 application is closed. The 2027 to 2028 application opens in mid January 2027.

name: Mayor's YouthWorks Initiative
org: City and County of Denver, Economic Development and Opportunity
what_you_do: Get a job on your own, work at least 100 hours over the summer, and the city pays you a $250 bonus in the fall. The city also runs job fairs and gives job help.
deadline_text: The 2026 cycle closed: apply by Monday, July 6, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted. Check the city page in spring 2027.

name: Teen Science Scholars
org: Denver Museum of Nature and Science
what_you_do: Spend three weeks in a summer internship with museum scientists on a research track. Some tracks include outdoor fieldwork. Lunch vouchers and materials are covered.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed and the page gives no 2027 dates. For 2026, interviews were expected in late March and early April, with offers in mid April.

what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard at a Denver pool. If you are not certified, the city trains you for free first. You may also teach swim lessons or help at the front desk.
deadline_text: Hiring year-round. The page gives no deadline.

name: Denver Parks and Recreation Volunteers: Free Youth Meals and Recreation
what_you_do: Help recreation center staff serve free meals to kids and teens. Meals can be breakfast, lunch, snacks or supper. You can also help with games and other activities.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.

name: ArtLab Paid Arts Internship
what_you_do: Join art and community projects at ArtLab. Interns get an hourly stipend. They also get help such as therapy, tutoring, and groceries.
deadline_text: The 2026-2027 application is closed. The next application window is January to March 2027.

name: Teen Advisory Boards (TAB)
what_you_do: Meet with other teens and library staff. Work on library projects with community partners. Help spread the word about library programs. Advise librarians.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadline.

name: Teen Volunteering at Denver Public Library
what_you_do: Teens 14 and up can apply to volunteer at the library.
deadline_text: The page says all current teen volunteer positions are filled. No reopening date is posted.

name: Western National Roundup (4-H and FFA contests)
what_you_do: Compete in contests like livestock judging, horse judging, meat judging, quiz bowl and public speaking. You meet 4-H and FFA teens from across the country.
deadline_text: Registration opened Oct 5, 2026. Early bird ends Nov 16. Late registration ends Dec 1, 2026. Payments due Dec 30. Last day to book the listed hotels: Dec 14, 2026.

name: YMCA of Metro Denver Summer Jobs for Teens
what_you_do: Work at a Y in summer. Jobs are lifeguard, swim instructor, or part-time camp counselor. Lifeguards need lifeguard certification and CPR.
deadline_text: The program page gives no dates. It says the Y recruits every spring.

name: Douglas County Young Adult Employment Program (DCYEP)
what_you_do: Get help finding a job and planning a career. Learn work skills, resume writing, and interviewing. Some teens get a paid internship.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Virtual information sessions are held three times a month. October 2026 sessions are Oct 1, Oct 23 and Oct 28.

name: Lamont Summer Academy
org: University of Denver, Lamont School of Music
what_you_do: Spend two weeks at the University of Denver music school. Play or sing in lessons, ensembles, and classes. Singers, players, and composers can all join.
deadline_text: The program page lists three dates for the 2027 session: Dec 15 for priority decisions, Feb 15 for scholarship consideration, and Mar 15 for regular applications. The page does not write the year.

name: Trail Stewardship Team
what_you_do: Work on a crew doing trail maintenance in Jefferson County parks. You use hand tools to move rocks, branches and dirt, and you hike two to six miles every day.
deadline_text: The 2026 applications are closed. The page lists 2026 interviews in April and a June 16 start. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Groundwork Denver Green Teams
what_you_do: Join a paid crew. You work on community gardens, rain barrels and local projects for fair treatment of the earth and its people in Denver neighborhoods.
deadline_text: Openings change. The page links to a current youth jobs list, last updated 2026.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Henderson library branch (Gibson, Green Valley, Paseo Verde or West Henderson). Tasks and hours are not listed on the page.

name: Zoo Corps Teen Volunteers (Hogle Zoo)
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the zoo in summer. They share what they know about animals, nature and the earth.
deadline_text: The page says Zoo Corps applications are due April 13 with interviews April 17 and 18. It does not name the year, so this is the usual pattern.

name: Cancer Research High School Program
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah, with the American Cancer Society
what_you_do: A two week virtual program with lab lessons using a science kit sent to your home. You receive up to $500 in financial compensation.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran February 10 to April 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: HCI-RISE: Remote Immersive Science Experience
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah
what_you_do: A virtual two week summer program on cancer research and health careers, with workshops, career panels and small group work. You are paid up to $400.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran February 10 to April 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: PathMaker Scholars Summer Research Program
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah
what_you_do: A 10 week summer research job in a University of Utah lab. You live on campus. You get weekly meetings, a research symposium and a chance to go to a national conference.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was February 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Junior Volunteers (Intermountain Health)
city: Salt Lake City and Lehi, UT
what_you_do: Teens may volunteer in a limited number of hospital roles. The page does not list the jobs.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

name: NM PREP High School Academy (NMSU)
org: New Mexico State University, College of Engineering
what_you_do: Spend a week on the NMSU campus doing hands-on engineering work. Topics include 3D printing, advanced manufacturing, engineering and math. You meet students from across the state and NMSU students.
deadline_text: In 2026, applications were open until Apr 30 and the High School Academy ran June 1 to 5. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Young Adult Employment: Lifeguard and Student Recreation Aide (City of Las Cruces)
org: City of Las Cruces Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Work for the city as a lifeguard at a pool or as a student recreation aide. Lifeguards keep swimmers safe. Aides help run fun programs for the public.
deadline_text: The program page does not list openings or dates. Check the city job page.

name: Batteries Included Teen Council
org: City of Las Vegas, with Clark County School District and Nevada Partners
what_you_do: Join a teen council at a high school or community center. You do after-school activities. They cover leadership, community service, career plans and college prep.

name: City of Las Vegas Aquatics: Lifeguard Training and Pool Jobs
org: City of Las Vegas Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Staff guard city pools, work the front desk and locker rooms, or do pool upkeep before opening. The city also offers Red Cross lifeguard classes you need for the guard jobs.
deadline_text: The 2026 flyer says the city hires for winter starts in Jan 2026 and keeps hiring through spring and into summer until jobs are filled.

name: Clark County Aquatics: Lifeguard, Cashier and Swim Instructor Jobs
what_you_do: Staff work as lifeguards, cashiers and swim instructors at county pools.
deadline_text: No dates are given on the program page. The page itself has no date.

name: Clark County Leaders of the Future (Teen Leaders)
org: Clark County Department of Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Volunteer as a Teen Leader at a county recreation center. You serve the community, build leadership skills and get job training.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page. Spots depend on openings at each center.

name: EmployNV Youth Hub at West Charleston Library

what_you_do: Label and stamp books and magazines, shelve DVDs and get crafts ready for regular programs. Also decorate for special events and help at them.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Volunteer at Three Square

name: Maricopa County Youth Workforce Services
what_you_do: Get free help with school, job skills, and careers. Some youth get paid work experience or an apprenticeship. You also get a mentor for 12 months.
deadline_text: Year-round. No deadlines are listed on the program page.

name: Failure Lab Teen Internship (MCA Denver)
what_you_do: A year-long teen internship. Fall: work with a Denver artist on an exhibition. Spring: plan and curate a teen art show with museum staff.
deadline_text: Applications open May through June for the next school year.

name: MoxieMag Teen Interns (MCA Denver)
what_you_do: High school interns make a printed and online teen magazine. They take field trips, hear guest speakers and work with museum staff.
deadline_text: Applications open mid-November to mid-December for spring, and May to June for fall.

name: Teen Artist-in-Residence
what_you_do: Local teens make art in a shared studio at the museum for 3 to 4 weeks. They get weekly demos and feedback from Denver artists and a public show at the end.
deadline_text: Application dates are not posted on the page.

name: Aquatics Junior Lifeguard
what_you_do: Volunteer at Mesa pools in summer. You build the skills and attitude to become a lifeguard later.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page gives only the season.

name: Teen Volunteer Application at Banner Desert Medical Center
org: Banner Desert Medical Center and Banner Children's at Desert
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital area. You might work at the info desk, family lobby, gift shop, food service or nursing units.
deadline_text: Summer Student Application is accepted only January to March. No other deadline stated.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Banner Heart Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer about 4 hours a week at a heart hospital. Volunteers help in different parts of the hospital.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: East Valley Fire Cadet Program
what_you_do: Learn basic firefighting skills, CPR and first aid. Practice climbing ladders and working hose lines. Build teamwork and leadership skills.
deadline_text: Sign-up is once a year in August. The 2026-2027 sign-up is closed. The page says to check back on August 1, 2027.

name: Teen Leadership Training (TLT)
org: City of Mesa Parks, Recreation and Community Facilities
what_you_do: Be a junior staff volunteer at Mesa summer camps: help with group games, crafts and swimming trips. Builds job skills.
deadline_text: Starts when Mesa summer camp registration opens. 2027 dates not posted in the FAQ.

name: Mesa Police Cadet Post 2055
what_you_do: Go to weekly meetings with hands-on police training. Learn about traffic stops and how police investigate. Do community service.
deadline_text: The post recruits twice a year. The program page says the next recruitment window is October 2025.

name: Nevada 4-H Capital Days
org: University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada 4-H
what_you_do: Visit Nevada's capital city to learn how a bill becomes a law. Follow bills and sit in on committee hearings. Tour the Legislative Building. Meet your state lawmakers.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline posted on the page.

name: Nevada 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a county 4-H club and pick projects to explore. Take part in county activities, camps, workshops and the county fair.
deadline_text: Join any time, but join by your county's 4-H enrollment deadline to take part in Fair.

name: WNC Dual Credit for High School Students
what_you_do: Take a Western Nevada College class and earn college credit and high school credit at the same time. Your high school decides which WNC classes count.
deadline_text: The program page points to WNC's dates and deadlines page. No deadline is stated on it.

name: Nevada Youth Legislature
org: Research Division, Nevada Legislative Counsel Bureau
what_you_do: Serve two years as a Youth Legislator for your Senate district. You go to trainings, hold a town hall, testify, and help write a bill for the Nevada Legislature.
deadline_text: The program page does not post a current deadline. The brochure says to check the program website for deadline details.

name: New Mexico 4-H
what_you_do: Pick projects like livestock, robots, cooking or public speaking. Join a club in your county with adult volunteers.
deadline_text: The 4-H year runs October 1 to September 30. Enrollment usually opens in October. Deadlines vary by county.

name: New Mexico Agricultural Education and FFA Association
what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's ag program. The site lists career development events, a leadership camp and FFA Day at the Roundhouse.
deadline_text: Join through your school's ag program.

name: Forest Stewards Youth Corps (Summer)
what_you_do: Work on a crew that builds trails and fences and fixes wild places. You learn about forest care, fire and water health. You earn a paycheck.
deadline_text: The page contradicts itself. Its menu says FSYC Summer Hiring (Closed), but the text says the program is hiring now. No 2027 hiring dates are posted.

name: Conservation Crew Corpsmember (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico)
org: Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico
what_you_do: Join a paid outdoor crew. You build trails, fight invasive plants, restore land and help prevent fire danger. You work with a team in Albuquerque or Taos.
deadline_text: The 2027 Corpsmember jobs list a start date of March 18, 2027. The apply page does not give a last day to apply.

name: WIOA Youth Program, Central Region
what_you_do: Help finding a job for youth in school and out of school. You also get work experience, skills training, mentors, leadership training and follow up help.
deadline_text: No deadline. The program runs year-round.

name: WIOA Youth Program, Northern Region
city: Santa Fe and northern New Mexico
what_you_do: Free job training with a paid work placement with a local employer. You also get mentors, money skills training and 12 months of follow up help.
deadline_text: No deadline. The program runs year-round.

name: New Mexico Youth Conservation Corps (YCC)
org: New Mexico Youth Conservation Corps Commission, EMNRD
what_you_do: Get a paid job on a crew doing public conservation work that helps your community, with job training and career development. Local sponsors run the crews.
deadline_text: Set by each sponsor. The state page lists funded projects by year.

name: Critical Action Lab (Natural History Museum of Utah)
what_you_do: Teens plan events for other teens about taking action in their towns. Events include a Youth Climate Summit, game nights, nature fairs and clean ups.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026 to 2027 group are closed. The page says to check back later.

name: Teen Explainers (Natural History Museum of Utah)
what_you_do: Paid high school interns lead hands on activities for museum visitors. They learn how to talk with the public and go on behind the scenes tours.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026 to 2027 school year group are closed. The summer group (June to August) is described on the page; the next dates are not posted.

name: Ogden Youth Council
what_you_do: Learn how city government works. You hear from elected leaders and tour Ogden City buildings. Members also go to Local Government Day at the State Capitol.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-2027 school year are open now. They close at the end of the school year. The page gives no exact date.

name: WSU Summer Medical Academy (Weber State University)
org: Weber State University, Pre-Medical Professional Program
what_you_do: Try out health care careers in a short summer camp. You do lab activities, hear from health workers and patients, and learn how to get ready for health school.
deadline_text: The 2026 session was July 13 to 16, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted. The page lets you sign up for notices about future sessions.

name: WeberBiz Summer Camp (Weber State University)
org: Weber State University, Goddard School of Business and Economics
what_you_do: Stay on campus for 4 days and 3 nights to try out a business major. You take classes with Weber State teachers, meet business leaders and compete in challenges for prizes.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Apr 24, 2026. The page says the deadline is typically the 3rd Friday in April. Applications open in March, and the interest form sends an email when they open.

name: Empowered Professionals of Tomorrow (UVU)
what_you_do: Take real college classes at UVU for seven weeks in the summer. Pick a track in science, engineering, education or business. You earn college credit and meet mentors.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was full and had a waitlist. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Volunteer Program (ages 15 and up)
what_you_do: Greet guests, help with demonstrations and hands-on activities, and prep science kits. Teens can also lead activities.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: AZYouthforce Internships
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley (BGCAZ)
what_you_do: First finish the 30 hour AZYF Academy for skills, mentors and career help. Then work a paid internship. Current listings are the AZPlays sports group internship with BGCAZ and Junior Sports Leadership Specialist.
deadline_text: Fall internships were listed as open. No deadline posted. Process takes about a month.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Do hands on volunteer work with staff and adult volunteers in different Garden teams. Roles can be short projects, seasonal or ongoing.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Use the Sign Up link on the volunteer page.

name: Summer Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Do a paid 5-week summer internship and job readiness workshops. Each participant gets a counselor.
deadline_text: Page says the 2026 application will open soon. No dates posted.

name: Medical and Nursing Explorers Clubs
what_you_do: Join a student run club that meets each month at a HonorHealth medical center. You explore health care careers (medical or nursing).
deadline_text: 2026-27 application is closed. 2027-28 application opens mid-May 2027.

name: Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Guide visitors and school tour groups through the music museum as a guide in one of several gallery roles. Training is provided.
deadline_text: No other deadline stated. The fall 2026 Museum Guide deadline of Sept 25, 2026 has passed.

name: Summer Lifeguard and Pool Jobs
org: City of Phoenix Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Work at a city pool. Jobs include lifeguard, shallow water lifeguard, swim lesson teacher, pool cashier or Buddy Bear mascot.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Certification classes are offered year-round.

name: Police Cadet Program
what_you_do: Meet on Tuesdays at 5:00 PM. Cadets serve a three-month probation with community service.
deadline_text: Orientations are held twice a year, before the school year and after winter break. Specific dates are not stated on the program page.

name: Summer Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help library staff with the Summer Reading program. Do it at a Phoenix library branch. Help for at least 4 weeks.
deadline_text: 2026 applications opened in April 2026 (release dated April 10, 2026). No deadline posted. Positions fill fast.

name: Phoenix R.I.S.E. Summer Internship
what_you_do: Work a paid part-time summer internship with the City of Phoenix to gain real work experience.
deadline_text: Applications closed for the summer 2026 session. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Sedav Vaaki Museum Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: Greet museum guests at the front desk. Share facts about the Ancestral Sonoran Desert People. Help get supplies ready for events.
deadline_text: Recruitment stays open until all positions are filled. Then a waitlist is created. Applications for the spring round closed January 10, 2026.

name: St. Mary's Food Bank Volunteering
what_you_do: Volunteer a shift at the food bank. Pick a site and activity in the online portal. Families can sign up together.
deadline_text: Sign up any time.

name: ZooTeens Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer one 5-hour weekend shift a month at the Zoo, from August to May.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications closed May 31, 2026. Join the interest list for 2027-28 dates.

name: Teen Volunteers at Pikes Peak Library District
what_you_do: Teens can see current volunteer chances through a link on the library teen volunteer page. The page does not list specific duties.
deadline_text: The page does not list volunteer dates. It links to current teen volunteer opportunities and gives a contact for questions.

name: TWIG: Teens Working in the Garden (Red Butte Garden)
org: Red Butte Garden, University of Utah
what_you_do: Work next to horticulture staff doing weeding, raking, pruning and other garden jobs. Learn about plants, build job skills and work as a team.
deadline_text: The page says dates, schedules and the application will be announced. It says to check back in the spring.

name: City of Reno Junior Lifeguards
org: City of Reno Parks and Recreation, Aquatics
what_you_do: Take a four day junior lifeguard class for ages 11 to 14. You earn Red Cross CPR/AED and first aid certification, valid for two years.
deadline_text: The 2026 sessions listed are Oct 5 to 8 and Dec 28 to 31. No registration deadline is stated.

name: City of Reno Red Cross Lifeguarding Class
org: City of Reno Parks and Recreation, Aquatics
what_you_do: Take the Red Cross lifeguard class at Moana Springs. You earn a lifeguard certificate, plus CPR/AED and first aid certificates.
deadline_text: No application deadline is stated. The 2026 class dates run from Sept 19 to Dec 24, 2026.

name: City of Reno Parks Volunteer Program
org: City of Reno Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Help with one day tasks or events with Reno Parks and Recreation. Under 16 needs a parent signed release. Ages 16 and older can take regular scheduled tasks.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Camp Discovery Teen Assistant Program
what_you_do: Help run hands-on STEAM camp activities for kindergarten to 7th grade campers. Earn over 80 community service hours.
deadline_text: No deadline or program dates listed.

name: CBESS Student Researcher Program
org: University of Nevada, Reno Raggio Research Center
what_you_do: Spend a week on campus plus 2 or more weeks online in a summer research program. Then plan a student led research project on a community health issue.
deadline_text: No deadline or dates posted on the page.

name: Engineering Summer Camps for Ages 14 to 17
org: University of Nevada, Reno College of Engineering
what_you_do: Pick one high school camp. The page lists the Aerospace Mini-Camp, the Engineering Adventures Camp and a Civil and Environmental Engineering Camp. Camp details are not posted yet.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 registration opens February 1 (2027 inferred from the Summer 2027 label on the page).

name: UNR High School Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes at the University of Nevada, Reno. Classes can count for high school credit and college credit. You can take up to 8 credits each semester.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the program page.

name: Women in STEM High School Outreach Program
what_you_do: Join a year-long program about STEM careers. You go to campus events, tour labs, meet advisors and mentors, and build a plan for college.
deadline_text: The program page lists the 2024 to 2025 application, which opened June 1, 2024 and stayed open until spots were full. No newer dates are posted.

name: Volunteen
what_you_do: Earn up to 20 volunteer hours by finishing activity badges. Do them online with Beanstack or with a paper workbook. A coordinator checks your work.
deadline_text: No start, end or deadline dates listed.

name: Youth Conservation Corps (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps)
what_you_do: Join a crew of 8 to 10 peers and two crew leaders for two or four weeks of trail building, restoration and work on invasive species and wildlife habitat. You camp together at night.
deadline_text: Dates are not posted on the page.

name: Teen Squad (The City Library)
org: Salt Lake City Public Library (The City Library)
what_you_do: Work with a librarian for six weeks to set goals and build a project. You earn volunteer hours and learn job skills.
deadline_text: Apply through February 17, 2027.

name: High School Summer Research Internship (University of Utah Engineering)
org: University of Utah, John and Marcia Price College of Engineering
what_you_do: Students spend 8 weeks in a university lab. They are matched with a faculty member and do research. They go to orientation and a final poster presentation.
grades: Rising seniors (graduating in 2028 on the current page)
deadline_text: Registration and teacher recommendations are closed on the program page. No future deadline is posted.

name: Summer Mathematics Program for High School Students (University of Utah)
org: University of Utah Department of Mathematics
what_you_do: Students spend about three weeks on hard math problems and big ideas. The 2026 program focused on math and biology. Students earn three university credits.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 28, 2026. The page lists no 2027 dates.

name: Youth Volunteer Shifts at Utah Food Bank
what_you_do: Volunteers sort food and pack food boxes in the warehouse. Shifts are 90 minutes. Other jobs include delivering food boxes to homebound seniors. You can also help at school food pantries.
deadline_text: No deadline. Fill out the volunteer form and pick shifts.

name: YouthCity Child Development Internship (Salt Lake City)
what_you_do: Spend 6 weeks of summer working in a child care program. It is at a Salt Lake City youth program.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: YouthCity Government and Policy in Action (Salt Lake City)
what_you_do: High school students work with city leaders on city issues. They learn about public policy and public sector careers. They plan community service projects. They work with the police Promising Youth program.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 school year program is no longer taking applications. Summer 2026 programs ran June 9 to July 16. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: YouthCity Paid City Department Internship (Salt Lake City)
org: Salt Lake City Youth and Family Division
what_you_do: Teens work for 8 weeks in a Salt Lake City department. They go to workforce trainings, build a resume and plan a career path. Performance expectations match entry-level jobs.
deadline_text: The program page gives no application dates. It lists no dates for summer 2027.

name: Teen Volunteers and Teen Advisory Board (Salt Lake County Library)
what_you_do: Help at a county library branch. The library lists a Teen Advisory Board. Its meetings cover teen volunteer chances and upcoming programs.
deadline_text: No dates on the volunteer page. It says to contact your local branch.

name: Salt Lake County Internships for High School Students
what_you_do: County offices hire interns for work that depends on the office. The county lists some internships for school credit and some that pay. Each job post names the duties.
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the program page. Check the county job board for current posts.

name: Young Curators
what_you_do: A free after school program. High school students write about art, learn about jobs in art and museums, and work together to put on an exhibit.
deadline_text: Application dates not posted on the page.

name: Santa Fe YouthWorks Youth Corps and Job Training
what_you_do: Get paid job training in Santa Fe. Youth crews do work like fire danger reduction, river and watershed care, farming, construction and cooking. You build job skills and good work habits.
deadline_text: No dates on the program pages. The page says to connect with YouthWorks to learn about current offerings.

name: Teen Volunteers at Scottsdale Public Library
what_you_do: Help at the library and earn documented volunteer hours. Some teens are Reading Buddies who work closely with school-age children over the summer.
deadline_text: School year: fill out the interest form on the program page. Summer applications are open April 1 to 30 (Civic Center and Mustang libraries only). Summer 2026 applications have ended.

name: Scottsdale Teen Employment Program (STEP)
org: City of Scottsdale, Vista Career Center
what_you_do: Get one-on-one job help from a teen employment specialist. They help with your resume, practice interviews, and job search. They give job referrals when they can.
deadline_text: No deadline. Make an appointment any time. The fall and spring job skills events are postponed.

name: Highwater Farm Fall Youth Intern
what_you_do: Grow and sell fresh food. Lead volunteer groups. Give talks in schools. Join community events on Fridays and Saturdays.
deadline_text: Dates for the next session are not posted. You must do the summer program first.

name: Highwater Farm Summer Youth Crew
what_you_do: Grow and sell vegetables on the nonprofit farm. You use hand tools like shovels, rakes and wheelbarrows. You do not need any farm or work experience. You join team activities, workshops and community events.
deadline_text: 2026 positions are closed. The page says to check back in January 2027 for the next round of applications.

name: BuzzCamp (New Mexico Tech)
what_you_do: Spend a week on the New Mexico Tech campus doing coding, hands-on workshops and real STEM challenges. Rising 11th and 12th graders can earn one college credit hour.
deadline_text: BuzzCamp 2026 was full and had a waitlist. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Summer STEM Experience (New Mexico Tech)
what_you_do: Live like a college student for a week. You study one science or engineering topic. The page says you can earn college credit.
deadline_text: The page is for the 2026 session and does not show dates. Check the page for the next session.

name: High School Conservation Crews (Southwest Conservation Corps)
city: Four Corners and Los Valles regions, CO
what_you_do: Join a paid outdoor crew in your region for 4 to 5 weeks. Do conservation work, get food in the field, safety gear and lessons from trained staff.
deadline_text: The page has an Apply link for Summer 2026 but shows no closing date. No 2027 dates are posted.

name: Youth Coalition Member (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps)
org: Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico
what_you_do: Join the Youth Coalition Member job in Taos, NM. It is part of the Prevention Program.
deadline_text: The job runs from Oct 9, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027. The apply page does not give a last day to apply.

name: High School Internship in Cybersecurity Research
org: ASU Center for Cybersecurity and Trusted Foundations
what_you_do: Do about 8 weeks of cybersecurity research on the ASU Tempe campus. You work 15 to 20 hours a week and meet in person each week.
deadline_text: Not offered in summer 2026 (paused). Planned to relaunch in summer 2027. No dates or opening posted.

name: Growing Leaders (Thanksgiving Point)
what_you_do: Teens help with learning activities, help with events and learn leadership. They gain experience in teaching, event planning and customer service. They work with staff and volunteers.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

name: SheTech Internship (Thanksgiving Point)
what_you_do: High school girls do real STEM projects. Topics include insects, exhibit design, wetland repair, growing plants in water, coding lessons and school programs.
deadline_text: Dates and deadlines are not posted on the page.

name: Individual Volunteer (Tracy Aviary)
what_you_do: Volunteer at Tracy Aviary. Help with ongoing jobs at the aviary, and meet people who share an interest in birds. Group projects are mostly outdoors.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Teen Volunteer (ages 15 and up)
what_you_do: Talk with visitors and help staff run activities. Keep the museum clean and ready. Help with camps and special events.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Tell them your due date if you need service hours.

name: Junior Staff in Training
org: City of Tucson Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Build leadership skills and prepare for future work in recreation. Participants may work up to 30 hours per week.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.

name: City Lifeguard Jobs and Starguard Classes
org: City of Tucson Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Pass a swim test, take the Starguard lifeguard class, then work as a city pool lifeguard.
deadline_text: Swim tests Nov 1 and Nov 29, 2026, 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Sign up for a swim test at the link. Starguard class days on the page (no years printed; the page footer reads 2026): Oct 4, 10, 11 (already passed as of 2026-10-13); Nov 14, 15, 21, 22; Dec 12, 13, 19, 20.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Work with other teens and librarian mentors on projects at a Pima County library branch. Teens log their own hours.
deadline_text: No deadlines listed.

name: Summer Youth Employment Program
org: Pima County Community and Workforce Development
what_you_do: Work a paid summer internship at a Pima County site, learn new skills and attend summer school.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Feb 2 to Feb 27, 2026 at 5 p.m. and are closed. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Zoo Crew Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teach zoo guests about animals, nature and the earth on Zoo grounds. Teens manage their own schedules.
deadline_text: Zoo says it will reopen Zoo Crew in January 2027 for the Spring 2027 class. Training is in late May and all days are required.

name: KEYS Research Internship 2027
what_you_do: Do a 7 week research project in a University of Arizona science lab. A scientist is your mentor. Earn 3 units of college credit.
deadline_text: Applications open Nov 2, 2026. No closing date posted; recommendations are due Jan 7.

grades: High school juniors and seniors (juniors favored)
name: Disadvantaged High School Student Summer Research Program
org: University of Arizona College of Medicine, Tucson
what_you_do: Work as a paid summer research helper. It is at the University of Arizona College of Medicine in Tucson. The research is medical.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline listed on the page.

name: 4-H Healthy Living Ambassadors Club
org: Tucson Village Farm, Pima County Cooperative Extension, University of Arizona
what_you_do: Be a teen leader who promotes healthy habits and caring for the earth. Do hands-on projects. Go to monthly meetings at the farm. Do community service.
deadline_text: Registration closed October 1, 2026. The required info meeting was September 24, 2026. Next year not posted.

name: Tucson Village Farm Camps: Teen Leadership and Counselor Roles
org: Tucson Village Farm, Pima County Cooperative Extension, University of Arizona
what_you_do: Help run summer camps for kids at the farm. The page says teens can apply for leadership and counselor roles. Camps cover cooking, farm life, art, river rafting and more.
deadline_text: Counselor applications for 2027 camps go live Monday, March 1, 2027 at noon.

name: UCCS Pre-Collegiate Program
what_you_do: A free program that lasts several years and helps students plan for college and careers. It has a summer academic institute in June. Older students can earn 3 free college credits.
deadline_text: The Colorado Springs application link will be available at the end of January 2027.

name: UCHealth Hospital Volunteering (age 16 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteer at a UCHealth hospital. Teens 16 and up can apply. One site is the University of Colorado Hospital. It is in Aurora. Some other Denver area hospitals take teens too.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed for the Aurora hospital on the volunteer page.

name: PATHS (University of Utah)
org: University of Utah, Continuing and Community Engagement
what_you_do: A 4 year college access program for first generation students. Each year you join 2 weeks of summer camp. You also get monthly workshops and weekly online mentoring and tutoring.
deadline_text: The page does not post the priority deadline yet. No dates are posted for the next group.

name: Utah 4-H Mock Legislature
city: Utah State Capitol, Salt Lake City, UT
what_you_do: Study bills, present one in committee and debate it on the House floor of the Utah State Capitol.
deadline_text: 2026 event was April 22, 2026. 2027 date not posted.

name: Utah 4-H Teen Summit
what_you_do: A leadership event on the USU campus. It has workshops to build leadership skills and friendships. The cost includes meals, a place to sleep, workshop supplies and a t-shirt.
deadline_text: Registration opens summer 2027. Deadline not posted.

name: Utah 4-H Teen Winter Retreat
what_you_do: A weekend retreat. It has workshops on how to talk with people and have healthy friendships. It has winter fun like snowshoeing and skiing. College 4-H members speak on a panel.
deadline_text: Registration Nov 1 to Jan 8, or until filled.

name: Utah 4-H
what_you_do: Join clubs, camps and hands-on projects in farming, science, leadership and healthy living. Sign up through your county 4-H program.
deadline_text: Join through your county 4-H office.

name: Paid Work Experience for Ages 14 to 24 (Utah Workforce Services)
what_you_do: Paid internships help you try out careers and build skills. An employment counselor gives coaching, a career check and money support. The goal can be on-the-job training that leads to a lasting job.
deadline_text: The program page does not list a deadline.

name: Seasonal Jobs at Lagoon Amusement Park
what_you_do: Lagoon hires seasonal staff for its park. The job list has many kinds of jobs. Each job post names the duties.
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the program page. The page still says it is hiring for the 2024 season, so call to confirm the current year.

name: Pre-Employment Transition Services (Pre-ETS)
org: Utah State Office of Rehabilitation, Vocational Rehabilitation
what_you_do: Free help for students with disabilities. You explore careers, get ready for work, learn to speak up for yourself and try work based learning.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Utah Summer Agriculture Program (Supervised Agricultural Experience)
org: Utah State Board of Education, Career and Technical Education
what_you_do: Do a summer farm project. You can raise animals, work at a farm business, run a small farm business or do service. Your ag teacher visits and tracks your work in an online tracker.
deadline_text: Teachers send in their plan and roster April 15 to 30 each year. Ask your ag teacher when to sign up.

name: Employee U
what_you_do: Take part in a flexible 8 week program. Go to lunch and learn sessions on work skills. Do volunteer work. You get a certificate and a letter of recommendation.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Careers for Youth and Young Adults (Workforce Colorado Jefferson, Clear Creek, Gilpin)
org: Workforce Colorado Jefferson, Clear Creek, Gilpin
city: Golden, CO (Jefferson, Clear Creek and Gilpin counties)
what_you_do: Job search help and career coaching. You get links to paid and unpaid work experience and hiring events for young adults. The office also helps with the Governor's Summer Job Hunt.
deadline_text: No deadline. Call or book a Career Coach appointment.
